Please create a u-shaped profile. The cross section should be 70mm wide and 40mm high. The web thickness needs to be 5mm. The profile should be 450mm long. | First, describe in words and step by step how the user's request can be implemented using function calls only. After the description, I will ask you to prepare the function call for execution, but don't execute it until I explicitly request it.

Step-by-step concept (no function calls executed yet)

1. Set up a local right-handed coordinate system  
   • X-axis = profile length (450 mm)  
   • Y-axis = profile overall width (70 mm)  
   • Z-axis = profile overall height (40 mm)  
   The global origin (0, 0, 0) will be the rear-left-bottom corner of the channel.

2. Create the outer channel envelope  
   • One rectangular block whose edge lengths are  
     – x_size  = 450 mm (length)  
     – y_size  = 70 mm  (overall width)  
     – z_size  = 40 mm  (overall height)  
   • Basepoint (x, y, z) = (0, 0, 0)  
   • subtraction = False (this establishes the initial solid volume).

3. Carve out the U-shaped hollow (open at the top)  
   • Second rectangular block, identical length but reduced width/height by the 5 mm web thickness:  
     – x_size  = 450 mm (length unchanged)  
     – y_size  = 70 mm – 2 × 5 mm = 60 mm  
     – z_size  = 40 mm – 5 mm = 35 mm  
   • Basepoint offset so that 5 mm walls remain on bottom and both sides:  
     – (x, y, z) = (0, 5, 5)  
   • subtraction = True (this removes the inner volume, leaving the bottom and side webs).

4. End: the resulting solid is a 450 mm long U-profile, 70 mm wide, 40 mm high, with 5 mm wall thickness, open on the Z-positive side.
